title: Divide, CO
quote: Divide was the connecting point between the Colorado Midland Railway and the Midland Terminal Railway, located at milepost 27.4. The station was originally known as Hayden's Divide. ... Today, the old Colorado Midland station sits to the south of US 24 and east of Colorado Highway 67.

title: The Midland Terminal Railway
quote: Construction started at Divide during December of 1893 ... The last revenue train operated on 20 Feb 1949.

title: Restoration at Midland Depot chugs along
author: Doug Fitzgerald
quote: The depot, built in 1886, burned a year later and built again in 1903.
